lightship.rule: Seeded 2026-09-24 so stern + 1 middle + bow = today's steamer mass (hullform.json massKg x 0.42^3 = 31906.6 kg), split by each section's table volume to the deck. Wheel, carrier and chimney carry 0: today's mass is one lump.

holdCells.source: 16 x this section's table volume to the deck / the Long ship's, largest remainder

berths.source: today's deck stations standing in this section on the Long ship

gunSlots.source: today's gun pair 2 (z 1.09 m, 4.69 u into the bay)

capacity.rule: Seeded 2026-09-24 (A4) ONCE so stern + 1 middle + bow = today's steamer exactly (16 hold cells, 8 berths, 6 guns = 3 pairs): hold cells = 16 split by each section's hydrostatic-table volume to the deck (largest remainder); berths = today's 8 deck stations (SteamerBootstrap.DeckStation) counted in the section whose X range contains them; gun slots = the port/starboard deck slot nearest to today's gun socket (hullform.json gunSockets, x0.42) in the section that contains it.
